Country.evidence_source: The present study sought to investigate the following hypotheses. First, most previous investigations of the factor structure of the BAS-2 have found a one-factor structure.1,11 We expected, following an exploratory factor analysis (EFA), that our Arabic version would also yield a similar result. Second, participants completed additional measures of body image and body pride which enabled an analysis of the convergent validity of the BAS-2. We hypothesized, in line with previous investigations,3–5,8 that scores on the Arabic BAS-2 would be significantly and positively associated with scores on the body image and body pride measures but negatively associated with body mass index (BMI) which we ascertained through self-report of height and weight. We also report on the internal consistency of all the measures.

Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Body appreciation is most frequently measured using the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2).

section_summary.extract_value: This introduction discusses the concept of body appreciation, its measurement using the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), and its cross-cultural validity. The present study aims to develop and investigate the psychometric properties of an Arabic-translated version of the BAS-2 in the United Arab Emirates, noting the lack of previous research in Arab populations. The study hypothesizes a one-factor structure for the Arabic BAS-2 and expects negative associations with self-reported BMI.
